description: This file defines the base activity class 'SampleActivityBase' for an Android application, providing common setup like logging initialization that other activities can extend.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class that extends FragmentActivity and sets up logging capabilities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes the activity, currently only calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes logging when the activity becomes visible.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain by creating a LogWrapper and associating it with the Log class; logs a 'Ready' message.
